b_quantities.E1_J_over_idle_given_t: W over idle at the measured op time: W = A + B / t_meas (the predictor's W_affine at the run's conditions), against the primary view's dP_w; relative (= J over idle given t) when the case's mean MM1-v3.1 W given t and its mean measured dP_w are both 3 W or more; else a WATTS case, scored by the mean of its runs' W - dP_w in watts (E215's form; the watts set is fixed by MM1-v3.1 and the measurement, the same set for every model and for E2; Q1 of the switch test keeps Q218's own condition, the measured dP_w >= 3 W)
b_quantities.E2_J_over_idle_t_forecast: (W_fc x T_fc) / (dP_w x t_meas) - 1, W_fc the predictor's W over idle at its own op time T_fc; at a watts case W_fc - dP_w in watts
b_quantities.E3_J_at_rest_given_t: (P_rest + W given t) / (P_rest + dP_w) - 1, P_rest = p_mean_w - dP_w (the run's rest, measured, given)
b_quantities.E4_J_at_rest_t_forecast: (P_rest + W_fc) x T_fc / ((P_rest + dP_w) x t_meas) - 1
b_quantities.T1_wall: cycles an op, the slowest minion: forecast cycles_per_op_wall (T x f, f the run's measured clock) / cyc_op_max - 1
b_quantities.T2_counter_mean: the counter's mean cycles an op: forecast cycles_per_op_mean / cyc_op_mean - 1
b_quantities.T3_seconds: seconds a GEMM: ops x T_forecast(us) x 1e-6 / t_pass_s - 1 (ops = 64 MB NB KB a minion). By the reducer (reduce_mms.py: T_op_us = wall / ops, cyc_op_max = sum cycles / ops, kclock = sum cycles / wall, t_pass_s = wall / passes) and with the forecast made at the measured clock, T3's error equals T1's identically: both are scored and printed
b_quantities.conditions_read_in_step_2: step 2 reads from each committed data-e214-<s>.json ONLY: the top-level card, session and primary_view, and per run: run, i, ran, role, arm, values, type, shires, minions, die_start_c, and the primary view's kclock_mhz and rails.minion.mV. No time, cycles, power, energy or seconds field is read before step 3.
b_quantities.how_each_model_is_called: at each run's measured conditions, as MM1-v3 README section 5 (the unread S4 form): the primary view's kernel clock kclock_mhz; minion volts: aifoundry1 card 1 the models' footing 0.517 V (data_v3.cases, MM1-v2's default), aifoundry1 card 0 the primary view's minion rail mV / 1000 (else mm1_core_v3.volts); the governed base by the model's own G_of_f(card, f); the run's die_start_c (50 C when absent). MM1-v3.1: mm1_v31.Model(out/mm1_v31_params.json).predict_many; MM1-v3: mm1_v3.Model(out/mm1_v3_params.json).predict; MM1-v2: unread_v2_e212.call (MM1-v3's caller of MM1-v2: card 1 V None (0.517 footing), G 0; card 0 the measured volts; energy for random, zeros and ones only, any other kind NOT FORECAST in energy; no die term). Kernel rgm136 (E214 runs rgm136 gemmL only). Time is kind-blind in every MM1.
b_quantities.split: per card (aifoundry1 card 1 at 600 MHz; aifoundry1 card 0 at low power under its governor), per format and kind, configuration twins apart

c_metric.case: a case's error = the mean of its runs' errors (each run at its own conditions; Q218's form); per-run figures REPORTED beside
c_metric.error: forecast / measured - 1 (the MM1 convention); rms % and signed mean (bias) %; watts cases rms and mean in W
c_metric.twins: per model: a time case is a twin when (card, kernel, arm, format, mask, the mean of its runs' clocks to 25 MHz) is in that model's TRAINING time configurations (its landed out/points_time_*.csv, E146 store rungs out); an energy case when that key and its energy kind are in the model's energy configurations (out/points_energy_*.csv; an energy point's clock its time record's, else 600 MHz on a pinned card) (work/step1/twin-keys.json). The no-twin cases carry the pass rule and the headline; twins and all cases are printed beside.

d_comparisons.d: per case, d = |ln(1 + e_B)| - |ln(1 + e_A)| for the pair (A vs B) (A closer when d > tie); at a watts case |dW_B| - |dW_A| in W; over every case both models price (twins included); REPORTED beside over the cases that are twins for neither model
d_comparisons.rules: H1 wall, H2 counter mean, H3 seconds, H4 J over idle given t (E1), H5 J over idle with t forecast (E2): per card and pooled
d_comparisons.test: the exact two-sided sign test (binomial at 1/2) on the untied cases, alpha 0.05: A BETTER if p < 0.05 and A is closer in more cases; B BETTER the other way; NOT DECIDED otherwise; TOO FEW under 10 untied cases; NO DATA with none
d_comparisons.ties_how: E215's rule (rules_e215.ties_of): at or above the card's replicate floor, never below E209's (0.005 in ln for cycles and seconds, 0.01 for joules, 0.05 W): card 1 E215 arm B's registered ties; card 0 from E212 a1c0-S1/S2's pooled within-case spread (bands.json card0_floors)

e_phi.rule: MM1-v3's own formula, kinds_v3.phi(fmt, {"tiles": [file]}), over each new kind's registered tile file (one value a kind, KB classes alike), sha256 checked against arms.json; sparse50f/h/i: MM1-v3's own phi_of("sparse50")

e_switch.Q1: group S, W over idle given t: MM1-v3.1 + the counts against the null N = the mean over zeros, ones and random of the run's format of the same model's own W given t at the run's conditions (the same base; only the count's information differs); cases with dP_w >= 3 W
e_switch.Q2: group S, E210's metric, the share of D: e_D = [(W_fc(P) - W_fc(R)) - (W_P - W_R)] / D, D = W_R - W_Z measured, R and Z the random and zeros cases of the same card, arm, format and mask (measured means; W_fc(R) the same model's W given t, its runs' mean); for the null [(N(P) - W_fc(R)) - (W_P - W_R)] / D; cases with an R and a Z case and D > 0
e_switch.counts: MM1-v3.1: its own merged tables (MM1-v3's rows + 3e8991d0's) with counts-e214's 9 fp32 rows at S1 and S2 and 11 fp16/int8 rows added in memory by energy_v31's own loop (no key collides: asserted); MM1-v3: 3e8991d0's rows and counts-e214's added to energy_v3's E210C / SWT the same way (Q218's form). f_pass_rule.bands_how: E215's form (rules_e215.py, unchanged): 2 x max(B1, B2) rounded up to a whole percent, B1 MM1-v3.1's LOEO no-twin error over every point, B2 over this card's points (reproduced 29 of 29 of holdout_v31.json first); T3 takes T1's bases; watts band 2 x max(B1 W, B2 W, SD_rep) rounded up to 0.01 W. Card 1's equal E215 arm B's registered bands (checked).
f_pass_rule.part_A: MM1-v3.1 by E215's rule form on each card over the NO-TWIN cases: a case passes T1, T2, T3, E3, E4 when |error| is within the band, E1, E2 when |error| is within the band or, at a watts case, |watts difference| within the watts band; a rule PASSES when at least 90% of its cases pass, FAILS otherwise, TOO FEW under 10 cases, NO DATA with none. PART A PASSES when no rule FAILS on either card and at least one rule PASSES; FAILS when any rule fails (named).
f_pass_rule.part_S: Q218's P1-P4 for MM1-v3.1 + the counts against N on group S, pooled over both cards: P1 rms(Q1) < N's; P2 the exact two-sided sign test on d = |e_N| - |e_V| per case, a tie when |d| < 0.01, holds when p < 0.05 and MM1-v3.1 is closer in more; P3 rms(Q2) < N's; P4 P2's test on Q2 (ties |d| < 0.01 of D). PART S PASSES when P1-P4 hold; NOT DECIDED when either sign test has fewer than 6 untied cases; else FAILS (named).
f_pass_rule.verdict: PASS when part A and part S pass; FAIL when either fails (named); NOT DECIDED otherwise. Decided by scripts/s03_score.py (hashed before the read). The comparisons (section d) are verdicts of their own, never part of PASS.
